scope: Current factual package for the members-only Nightmare Zone north-west of Yanille. It proposes facts, actions, graph relationships, and report-only observations; it does not select five quests, a boss list, a combat method, a reward target, or a route order.

included: current access, transport, eligible quest/boss roster, mode/difficulty costs, dream mechanics, points, power-ups, safety, reward-shop stock, and exact imbue costs
fixed requirements and deterministic shop/refund rules once the relevant account state is explicitly observed
Nightmare-Zone-only potion handling, alternative imbue systems, Hard Combat Achievement discount, and the Ardougne elite diary's location-specific Salve requirement
explicit account-observation requirements for combat state, boss availability, points, time, XP, purchases, imbues, and collection-log/drop state
excluded: a recommended five-quest threshold package, enabled-boss list, equipment setup, low-Hitpoints technique, AFK duration, stop condition, or final progression route
assumed combat readiness, completed quests, defeated bosses, coins, dream entry, points, time, XP, consumable stock, purchases, imbues, Slayer task, or successful exit
fixed points-per-hour, XP-per-hour, supplies-per-hour, success rate, attention interval, or expected return from a community method
a claim that Nightmare Zone, Soul Wars, or Emir's Arena is universally the preferable imbue path

requirements.minigame_gate: At least five completed quests from the eligible roster. Completion, boss availability, and Grouping-teleport readiness are separately observed.

location_and_transport: Grouping/Minigame Teleport: Nightmare Zone becomes usable only when the five-quest access condition is met.
Watchtower Teleport or tablet after Watchtower, then run east.
Yanille player-owned house Teleport to House/tablet, including a Yanille tablet made with a scroll of redirection.

Fairy ring CLS then north-west, or CIQ through Yanille; ring of dueling to Castle Wars; Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Village; Ardougne cloak 1 to the monastery; or Fishing Trawler Grouping teleport then south-west.
Every spellbook, tablet, charge, diary reward, tree/ring access, house location, current position, and travel outcome remains separately observed.

unlock_transition.event: player-confirmed completion of five eligible quests and arrival or valid minigame teleport
deterministic_effects: The player can speak to Dominic Onion and start an eligible dream after separately meeting the selected mode's coin and party conditions.
non_effects: Does not grant coins, combat levels, equipment, supplies, boss defeats, points, dream completion, reward ownership, an imbue, or a safe-exit result.

entry_inputs.behavior: required to start Nightmare Zone and use its Grouping teleport.
required for paid Endurance or Rumble modes; every grouped participant needs the applicable coffer amount.

entry_inputs.item_or_capability: combat, inventory, spell, prayer, equipment, and boss-selection state
entry_inputs.behavior: may affect an attempt but is never inferred from access or from a guide.

reusable_setup.effect: A paid Custom Rumble can toggle any boss unlocked from a completed eligible quest. Disabling a quest boss disables every boss from that quest.
The arena supplies required anti-dragon shield, magic secateurs, rune pickaxe, and Chronozon runes when relevant. These are instance-only and do not establish ownership outside the dream.
Store up to 255 doses of each sold NMZ potion type; withdraw desired doses before a dream without empty vials. Unused doses are not lost on ordinary dream death.

modes_and_costs.mechanics: One previously defeated boss, one-on-one, until player or boss death. No combat XP, NMZ points, or Slayer-task credit; normal drops can be awarded on boss defeat.

One-on-one waves through every currently unlocked boss until death or all are defeated. Observed boss kills award their listed mode points. Full current roster totals are 216634 normal or 794770 hard points.
Standard Rumble uses all unlocked bosses. Random-order duplicates spawn endlessly after observed kills; solo has at most four bosses at once and parties of up to five increase the concurrent maximum.
The host can toggle unlocked bosses. Missing bosses reduce per-kill points; exact selected roster, party, kills, point deltas, and results are observed.

difficulty.normal: Quest bosses use their quest stats and some quest mechanics.
difficulty.hard: Applicable Hitpoints, Attack, Strength, Magic, and Ranged levels increase; Defence and defensive bonuses normally remain unchanged with documented exceptions. Some bosses simplify to Melee while others gain mechanics, including The Untouchable reflecting 20 percent of dealt damage.
difficulty.boundary: A difficulty selection does not demonstrate capability to survive, damage, finish, or safely exit a dream.

eligible_boss_roster.quest: Recipe for Disaster - Freeing Sir Amik Varze

point_and_powerup_mechanics: The published boss table's normal/hard values are maximum per-kill points assuming every quest is complete and every boss enabled. In teams, points are split by damage; Rumble can only select bosses available to every party member.

If Dream Mentor bosses are enabled while Desert Treasure I bosses are disabled, all kills take an 83.33 percent (one-sixth) point penalty. Preserve selected quests/bosses as observations rather than automatically calculating a route's earnings.
One hard Rumble can award at most 1048575 points. The reward chest can hold at most 2147483647 points.

Rumble-only random power-ups disappear after one minute unclaimed: Recurrent damage lasts 45 seconds and adds a no-XP 75-percent follow-up hit; Zapper lasts one minute and damages nearby eligible bosses; Power surge lasts 45 seconds and restores/regenerates special attack; Ultimate force kills current bosses without NMZ points. Slayer credit/drop behavior for Ultimate force requires the player to have dealt at least one damage to the relevant boss.

Boss-specific attacks, requirements, immunities, reflections, poison, prayers, stat drains, supplied items, drops, kill credit, Slayer compatibility, and point delta require a selected-boss and observed-event model.

completion_or_reward_events.determinism: subtract the selected stated coin fee only from observed coins; no combat result, points, XP, or supplies are created.

completion_or_reward_events.event: player-confirmed boss kill or failed/ended dream
completion_or_reward_events.determinism: record only reported selected boss, difficulty, mode, points/XP/Slayer/drop deltas, consumables, and exit/death outcome. Published mechanics validate reports but do not synthesize them.
subtract the exact observed point cost and transform the selected confirmed item only after requirements are met; earning points and future utility remain external observations.

failure_and_death.ordinary_account_safety: Nightmare Zone is a safe instance. Ordinary dream death does not lose equipment; stored unwithdrawn potion-barrel doses are not lost.
failure_and_death.hardcore_group_iron_boundary: A Hardcore Group Iron death is not safe. To avoid life loss, leave by drinking a dream potion on the north or south side of the arena.
failure_and_death.exit_and_logout: Leaving the arena, drinking an exit dream potion, or a six-hour log ends the dream and restores stats to normal. Logging out inside the arena ends the dream and returns the player to the lobby.
failure_and_death.instance_boundary: Practice, Endurance, Rumble, party membership, current bosses, points during a dream, supplied items, power-ups, and combat events do not persist as inferred account state.

repeatability.cycle: A paid dream can be started again only with current access, observed coins, selected mode/party state, and player-confirmed entry.
repeatability.rng_boundary: A plan never implies continued attempts, selected boss order, survival, output, or a particular number of hours.

currencies.spend_behavior: Observed eligible Endurance/Rumble boss events can change this balance; Practice gives no points. Reward chest balance is capped at 2147483647. Spend only after an observed balance and selected valid purchase; never derive points from a planned boss list or time estimate.
Observed ordinary coins placed or available in the coffer. Entry fees are fixed by selected mode/difficulty but party, entry, and payment are observed.
Observed shop purchases create stored doses. Each potion barrel holds up to 255 doses; withdrawals and in-dream consumption are report-only.

rewards.requirements: Observed base item and 1250000 NMZ points, or 625000 after Hard Combat Achievements are claimed. Treat black-mask-to-helmet assembly state as observed.

rewards.requirements: Observed Salve amulet or enchanted Salve, 800000 NMZ points or 400000 after Hard Combat Achievements, Haunted Mine completion for the item, and NMZ access. Soul Wars and Emir's Arena versions do not satisfy the diary task.

utility: Ring of suffering(i) doubles equipment bonuses.
rewards.requirements: Observed base ring and 725000 NMZ points, or 362500 after Hard Combat Achievements.

utility: Ring of the gods(i) doubles Prayer bonus and gains holy-wrench effect while equipped.
rewards.requirements: Observed base ring, holy wrench in inventory, and 650000 NMZ points, or 325000 after Hard Combat Achievements.

utility: Berserker, warrior, archers, seers, tyrannical, and treasonous ring imbues each double equipment bonuses.
rewards.requirements: Each needs its observed base ring and 650000 NMZ points, or 325000 after Hard Combat Achievements.
Observed Granite ring and 500000 NMZ points, or 250000 after Hard Combat Achievements.

utility: Some Nightmare Zone bosses have listed drops and some can provide Slayer credit/XP when on an applicable observed task.
rewards.requirements: Selected eligible boss, player-confirmed kill/damage/assignment, and mode-specific rules. Practice boss kills can award drops but do not grant combat XP, NMZ points, or Slayer-task credit.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: Access requires any five completed quests from the live eligible roster; the model must record exactly which are confirmed rather than selecting a default five.
Needs observed NMZ access, 22000/26000 coins or maximum-quest-points 12000/16000 cost, and selected confirmed unlocked bosses.
The teleport is a transport convenience after observed NMZ access, not evidence of a completed dream or combat readiness.
Ironman-eligible deterministic Resources-tab purchase at 775 observed NMZ points; it supports Yanille house-tablet transport but does not move the player automatically.
A Salve imbued at NMZ, not a Soul Wars Zeal or Emir's Arena scroll imbue, is accepted. Completion remains player-confirmed.
Alternative item imbue path using Zeal Tokens, but it cannot be unimbued for NMZ points and does not qualify the NMZ-specific Ardougne task.
Alternative imbue path; uncharging returns the scroll, but it is not the NMZ-specific diary qualification.
Claimed Hard-tier reward halves NMZ imbue cost. Do not infer task completion or claim state from a desired discounted price.

Arena supplies named fight-critical items such as anti-dragon shield, secateurs, pickaxe, and Chronozon runes only inside relevant dreams; it does not bypass access, encounter readiness, or external ownership.

logout_or_idle_constraints: Combat, boss mechanics, poison/absorption exceptions, stat boosts, consumable availability, party state, power-up spawns, Rapid Heal interaction, target changes, six-hour logout, and safe exits depend on actual selected bosses, build, player actions, and mode.
A guide's low-attention or AFK claim does not prove a particular account can survive, maintain a potion state, avoid a Hardcore Group Iron death, or earn a stated output.
Record a player-measured elapsed time, interactions, supplied inventory, outcome, points, XP, and failures before any strategy layer compares NMZ to another activity.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Community AFK methods, boss lists, overload/absorption timing, low-Hitpoints techniques, and stop recommendations are strategy candidates only.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community guides commonly choose a small custom Rumble roster, combine absorption with overload or other boosts, and use a low-Hitpoints technique to reduce absorption damage.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: Do not assume rock cake/locator orb ownership, Hitpoints level, protection, potion stock, survival, attention period, XP, or points.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community material treats certain boss rosters as more convenient or higher-point and suggests particular Slayer or combat-training configurations.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: Boss availability, quest completion, gear, accuracy, task assignment, grouping, execution, and current mechanics vary. A central strategy model must score a supplied account state rather than adopt a roster here.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Established Ironman routes may schedule NMZ for redirection scrolls, a specific imbue, or combat training.
community_strategy_observations.boundary: The value of an imbue, transport tablet, points, time, combat XP, and opportunity cost belongs in later scoring; this package does not set a target or timing.

conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Published boss values are maxima under a fully enabled roster. Damage share, party, enabled quests, boss spawn order, power-ups, mechanics, selection, accuracy, and survival prevent automatic point/XP/kill estimates.

The Hard reward halves future imbue cost. To realize the current-cost refund behavior, an NMZ-origin imbue must be uncharged before claiming the reward; this is an observed transaction sequence, not an automatic recommendation.
Ardougne elite accepts an NMZ-origin Salve imbue/equip event. Equivalent Soul Wars or Emir's Arena imbues are mechanically valid items but do not satisfy this diary condition.
Current Wiki documentation states Ironmen may buy only scrolls of redirection from Resources. Model the other resource costs as factual stock, but do not expose them as Ironman purchases.
Guide rates, boss lists, absorption/overload timing, low-Hitpoints behavior, and stop advice are not normalized as deterministic readiness, throughput, or route content.
